text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, so this kind disappears after a 
single day. 
How did regular posts work again...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still, my fans are waiting for updates. 
...I should try a little harder...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, on Umastagram, Tact?! 
Good on you for sticking with it even 
though it's not your thing!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Word is you've gotten pretty good at 
handling it 
lately! Rulership told me so!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Trainer has been 
patiently teaching me the ropes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was completely lost... 
I didn't even know what kinds of photos I 
should take, 
so I found myself asking question after 
question, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yet Trainer never once looked bothered, 
even coming along with me to take 
photos...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And whenever hurtful comments popped up, 
Trainer would immediately check in to see 
how I was holding up.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, so your Trainer's been right there 
beside you through it all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Both in training and beyond. 
Trainer always faces me with absolute 
sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, I'm certain of it now. 
Your "destiny" is headed in a wonderful 
direction!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tact! Have faith in yourself 
and keep charging ahead!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! 
That is exactly what I intend to do.
